### Praying as a Servant
Author: Robert VanDoodewaard
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/praying-as-a-servant
Passage: Psalm 123:2
Points:
- Ancient servants possessed nothing of their own and relied entirely upon their master for provision.
- Praying like a servant means coming before God with empty hands and honest humility.
- Facing scorn from an arrogant world reminds believers that God owes us nothing.
- Although believers in Christ are adopted children, cultivating lowly dependence remains essential.
- Recognizing our own smallness removes entitlement and allows God's mercy to shine brightly.

### A Prayer for Recognizing God's Answers to Our Prayers
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-recognizing-gods-answers-to-our-prayers.html
Passage: Psalm 123:1
Points:
- Looking up to God on His heavenly throne reminds us of our deep, daily dependence on Him.
- Turning our gaze toward God anchors the heart when the surrounding world feels overwhelming.
- Just as servants watch a master's hand, believers should stay alert for God's answers in everyday life.
- Seeking the Lord keeps our hearts from absorbing cynicism and contempt from the surrounding culture.
- Praying the words of this psalm exchanges worldly chaos for the peace of Christ.
